data.title: Strive purchases $169M in bitcoin — nearly 6 times more than Strategy's recent buy
data.description: Strive (ASST) recently bought 2,000 bitcoin (BTC-USD) for about $169 million. Scott Melker discusses what this could mean for Strategy (MSTR).
